head_commit.message:
3SUM issues run as split builds; PRs stay one job

Lead, 2026-11-02 (issue #99): the 3SUM proof of #99 compiled one module at a time for 5 h 16 min in one
job (726 chains, 0 errors, 346 of 460 data batches) and ran out of time before the kernel check. The
split profile builds the solution in job 1 with one parallel lake build, and job 2 restores it.

- profiles/direct.json: 3sum gets "runner": "github-split". Its issues get split: true in the matrix.
- The PR route has no build job and never splits. pr_submissions now refuses only problems outside its
  folders (PR_PROBLEMS: dft, 3sum, apsp), not split profiles, so a 3SUM PR is still selected and runs in
  pr_verify, as before.
- verifier.chain_targets takes the split flag of the run (BOS_SPLIT, set by both issue jobs of
  submission-check.yml) instead of the profile runner: a 3SUM PR keeps the one-module-at-a-time chain
  build. A split flag on a profile without the split runner is refused.
- docs/execution.md and tests (runner values, matrix entry, chain targets, a 3SUM PR is selected, the
  BOS_SPLIT job env).

The receipt carries the profile, so the site import must accept the runner key before this lands
(site commit with the trust entry for this revision).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
